Neper looks progress

One widget set, five platform flavors in priority order (Windows, Linux, Neper, macOS / iOS, Android), each in a Light and a Dark look (docs/ui/looks-plan.md). Generated from docs/ui/looks/status.json and status.d by scripts/render_looks.py; updated 2026-10-18 14:10:30. 30 Delphi-equivalent controls and 16 platform idiom controls. A look with no status entry whose picture exists is shown as started: rendered from the platform palette, not compared with a real screen.

Completion is the weighted share of the 30 Delphi-equivalent controls in each look: planned 0 %, started 20 %, review 60 %, matched or ready 100 %. Overall is the mean of the five flavors; each flavor is the mean of its Light and Dark look. The weights are a rough measure of how close a control is, not an audit result; an independent audit sets the statuses (docs/ui/looks/audit.md). Matched means every state that has a real capture reproduces it; states with no capture stay unverified, so nothing reaches ready yet.

9 known gaps
  • Focus ring corners: GTK's 2 px outline has a 6 px outer and 4 px inner corner; ours is a border at radius 5.7, whose antialiasing differs by up to 10 levels on about 40 corner pixels per ring (the straight sides match)

  • Not verified at 150 %: the library was rendered at 1x and 2x only (the 1.5x sheet is rendered, not compared)
  • Hover and pressed are the library with state flags forced (arrows individually for the spin button), not a real pointer; the manifest's own entry/spin hover/active/focus crops were identical to rest or flagged on every child, so scripts/linux/gallery_l2.py re-captures the real states (FOCUS_WITHIN after a 200 ms settle, per-arrow hover and press, value 50)
  • Icons are the Adwaita symbolic SVGs (lib/e/ui/adwicon_l2.e, generated by scripts/linux/gen_icons_l2.py) drawn by e.gfx.svg; their pixels are set apart as coloured artwork
  • The date edit has no typed field under the Linux look (GTK's menu button is read-only); the Today and Clear footer is not drawn

  • The year and month turn buttons' hover and pressed tints and the day's hover are the flat button's; no capture
  • Day boxes are drawn on whole pixels; Neper snaps boxes, so the column pitch 37.83 is approximated by a 4.6 px offset

Gaps: no Neper equivalent yet

  • Embedded browser (TWebBrowser / TEdgeBrowser): No Neper control; listed, not built, on purpose: the plan is to recode D:/repos/vaper into Neper later and use it as the browser control (maintainer decision 2026-10-16).
  • Chart (TcxChart / TChart): e.gfx.chart draws charts but there is no chart control with a Windows look.
  • Tray icon (TTrayIcon): No Neper equivalent.
  • Native file dialogs (TOpenDialog / TSaveDialog): No Neper equivalent; the OS dialog is used.
  • Image combo box (TcxImageComboBox): No per-item image in Neper's combo box rows; control.image_select adds it for the Windows look and is the plain select under the others
